free_tier.stated: Free tier object storage: 15 GB of standard-class storage, 100 000 PUT, POST and LIST operations, 1 000 000 GET and HEAD operations, and the first 10 TB of outgoing traffic each month; the free volume covers standard-class storage only
free_tier.notes: The marketing page shows a standard, a cold and an ice panel together, at 15 GB, 1 000 GB and 3 000 GB; the documentation restricts the free volume to standard-class storage, so the cold and ice figures are panels of a calculator and not free capacity.

per_object_cap.stated: A single object is limited to 5 TB; one request uploads at most 5 GB and larger objects need multipart upload; in the cold and ice classes an object smaller than 128 KB is billed as 128 KB
per_object_cap.notes: the 5 TB object cap and the 5 GB per-request limit are tenant limits that cannot be raised; the storage volume itself is unlimited by default; a bucket created in the console can be given a maximum volume, buckets created through the API are unlimited in volume

retention.stated: Storage is billed on the largest volume held during each hour, at the tariff of the class the object is in
retention.notes: no minimum storage duration and no delete charge are stated on the pricing, class or free-tier pages

egress.terms: The first 10 TB of outgoing traffic each month is not billed in any storage class; beyond it traffic bills at 1,1712 ₽ per GB
egress.free_allowance: the first 10 TB each month, in any storage class
egress.price_per_tb: RUB 1 171,20 per TB beyond the 10 TB, billed at 1,1712 ₽ per GB

tooling: S3 API (rclone 's3' with a custom endpoint) — the free-tier page is explicitly 'Соберите свое Объектное хранилище S3'
chaining: The free path is 15 GB of standard-class storage plus the first 10 TB of outgoing traffic each month; a cold or ice bucket bills per GB-month at its class tariff, so an archive tier there is a paid tier.

limits.value: 15 GB of standard-class storage per organisation per month
10 TB of outgoing traffic per organisation per month, in any storage class
100 000 PUT, POST and LIST operations and 1 000 000 GET and HEAD operations per month

limits_note: The free tier is explicitly a test allowance: 'Ресурсы предоставляются исключительно для тестирования. Не подразумевается их безвозмездное предоставление' — i.e. a test allowance and not a standing free tier; 4,000 bonus roubles is credit-shaped and will expire

identity_cost.detail: Participation is limited to individuals, sole traders and legal entities registered in Russia. An individual registers with a phone number confirmed by SMS plus an email address, or with SberID. The account must hold at least 100 ₽ or 100 bonus points before any resource is created, and the 4000 bonus points are granted only after a bank card is bound.

reliability_note: the free volume is granted for an unlimited time from the date of the contract, the promotion itself runs to 31 December 2026, and the operator reserves the right to change quota sizes at any time; an account that starts no service within 60 days may be dropped from the promotion
confidence_note: every value is quoted from a first-party Cloud.ru page read on 2026-11-01; the marketing page's cold and ice panels are not a free allowance, which the service documentation contradicts. The identity gate is read from the promotion rules, not from the registration form itself.
